facts.text: Crisis PR writing is the discipline of communicating publicly during a reputation crisis that is not (or is no longer) a live operational incident. Examples:
An executive misconduct allegation surfaces
A data breach beyond the operational window - now a public-disclosure problem
A product recall or safety advisory
A supplier or partner exposure
A viral social-media controversy

The canonical reference response is Johnson & Johnson's 1982 Tylenol cyanide crisis: rapid acknowledgement, decisive action (a full 31-million-bottle recall), transparent media communication, and a visible product redesign.
A good holding statement:
Acknowledges that something happened
Expresses concern for anyone affected
States you are investigating
Promises a substantive update by a specific time
Names a point of contact
Never speculate. "We don't know yet" beats "we believe."
Never minimize. "An incident has been reported" beats "minor disruption."
Never blame externally on day one.
Always commit to a specific next update time.

facets.title: 4. SCCT response posture (Situational Crisis Communication Theory)

facts.text: Mismatch is the most expensive crisis-PR error. Treating a preventable-cluster crisis as a victim-cluster crisis creates the secondary crisis: "first they did it, then they lied about it."
Yes - CEO signs: preventable-cluster crises, executive-conduct issues, large-scale customer-impacting breaches.
No - Communications/Legal signs: routine product advisories, ongoing investigations where speculation is dangerous.
Every statement gets a version number, a timestamp, and an author. When facts change, supersede the prior statement publicly.
Holding statement (T+0 to T+60 min): Posted on company press page.
Substantive statement (T+2h to T+12h): Press release; emailed to affected customers.
Update cadence (T+24h, T+72h, then weekly): Posted in a single "incident log" page.

> Statement - November 14, 2026, 9:42 a.m. ET > > Acme Corp is aware of reports that customer account information may have been accessed without authorization. Our security team is actively investigating and has engaged independent forensic experts. The protection of customer data is a responsibility we take seriously, and we deeply regret any concern this causes. > > We will share a substantive update by 5:00 p.m. ET today, November 14. Customers with immediate questions can contact security@acme.com. Press inquiries: press@acme.com.
